subject.title: Stack-safe large attachment handling for Control UI and gateway

question: Should upgrades automatically discard only persisted composer entries whose failure is the historical attachment stack-overflow error, or should those records remain recoverable?
rationale: The parser hardening is a narrow bug repair, but deleting persisted queue entries is an intentional user-state migration that needs maintainers to choose the retention policy.

options.title: Approve narrow cleanup
options.body: Delete only records whose stored failure unambiguously matches the historical stack-overflow attachment path, preserving all other queued and failed entries.

options.title: Preserve failed records
options.body: Land only parser hardening and retain legacy failed entries until a user-visible recovery flow is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow cleanup
recommendation.body: Delete only records whose stored failure unambiguously matches the historical stack-overflow attachment path, preserving all other queued and failed entries.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership signals cover both the Control UI send path and persisted composer state implicated by the migration choice.
